items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 22, 2026
items.q: The transcript shows Monk Rowe is the interviewer and Wendy is the interviewee. There is no mention of any prior personal or professional relationship between them in the provided text.

ctx.x: Wendy was interviewed via Zoom on January 22, 2026 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very, very pleased to have Wendy Oxenhorn with me today. And you’ve presented a bit of a challenge as far as an introduction because you’ve done an awful lot in your life. So I came up – I don't know why I saw this but I’m going to call you the Red Cross for veteran jazz and blues musicians. How’s that?
And roots, and R&B, soul and rock & roll too.
